anna_fin: FYI invoice 2026-4473 from Tamás (HU) flagged for review. Vendor requests net payment with Redwood grossing up for withholding. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-4473.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-4473 flagged: missing TRC and gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

tamás_vendor: yes, we're a Hungarian Kft., tax id HU12345678. Contract clause mentions gross-up for royalties; i'll upload TRC and signed addendum.

miguel_sales: sales note: agreement references vendor "to be made whole" for withholding on royalties. Treasury prefers treaty check before auto gross-up.

katie_revops: Are these royalties or payments for services? Withholding rules differ. Also need signed gross-up addendum and bank match.

tamás_vendor: royalties (IP license). Uploaded TRC and Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-4473.pdf

anna_fin: Finance holding payment. Action items: tax to confirm treaty applicability and withholding rate; legal to confirm contract requires gross-up; verify bank IBAN last4.

katie_revops: vendor IBAN last4?

tamás_vendor: ****3456 (Erste Bank Hungary)

invoice-bot: Payment status: ON_HOLD by anna_fin

anna_fin: Tax ops answered offline: if TRC proves HU residency and US-HU treaty covers royalties, withholding can be reduced per treaty (possibly 0%), but TRC + signed declaration required. If treaty not applicable, default withholding 15% applies. Finance will not auto gross-up without legal sign-off on contractual obligation.

katie_revops: noted — if we gross-up, need GL approval for budget impact. Legal to confirm clause within 24hrs.

tamás_vendor: thanks — standing by to provide anything else.

invoice-bot: Thread note: "TRC and addendum received; legal review pending. Payment on hold."
